notes.title: ANYU Version 1.1
notes.content:
Gameplay  


Improved the starting area level design to clarify how to get the bag and get down.
Changed the lighthouse level to prevent the player from continuing without the backpack after climbing the first area, blocking the progression.
Changed the second forest level to avoid getting the backpack from the areas where after getting it the player would get stuck


Bug-fixes    


 Solved bugs with door, doors are only opened when all the buttons are pressed.
